name: wwbd
description: What Would Boris Do — engineering judgment channeled from Boris Cherny's published guidance, calibrated for a product-led, agent-maintained builder.

interface.longDescription: Channels Boris Cherny's published agentic-engineering judgment: verdict-first consults, build-time defaults (spec-first, verification loops, simplicity bias), and a from-scratch architecture review test.
defaultPrompt: What would Boris say about this architecture?
If Boris built this from scratch, would he build it the same way?
